The native Engine reproduces the selected Figiel model energies to printed precision, while the physical comparisons miss their printed values.
These are isolated scalar comparisons with different units and reference conventions; tables expose the signed deviations and criteria more clearly than a shared plot.
This notebook reads retained results only.
It has not been independently reviewed or promoted for manuscript use.

```{python}
import csv, json
from pathlib import Path
from IPython.display import Markdown, display
run = json.loads(Path('results/native-results.json').read_text())
rows = list(csv.DictReader(Path('results/comparisons.csv').open()))
quantities = run['quantities']
density = quantities[2]
refusal = json.loads(Path('results/density-input-refusal.json').read_text())
def table(selected):
    display(Markdown('| Case | Target | Calculated | Signed deviation | Criterion | Unit | Outcome |\n|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|---|\n' + '\n'.join('| ' + ' | '.join(str(r[k]) for k in ('case_id', 'source_value', 'computed_value', 'signed_error', 'absolute_tolerance', 'unit', 'outcome')) + ' |' for r in selected)))
display(Markdown(f"{len(quantities)} distinct quantities give {len(rows)} comparisons; {sum(r['outcome'] == 'reproduced' for r in rows)} reproduce the printed value. Conditions: {density['temperature_K']} K and {density['pressure_Pa']} Pa. Native calculation wall time, including diagnostic recomputations: {run['wall_seconds']:.6f} s."))
display(Markdown('### Physical comparisons'))
table([r for r in rows if r['evidence_label'] == 'physical comparison'])
display(Markdown('### Numerical verification against the printed model column'))
table([r for r in rows if r['evidence_label'] == 'numerical verification'])
display(Markdown('### Numerical evidence and bounded diagnosis'))
display(Markdown(f"Returned reference molality: {quantities[0]['reference']['molality']} mol/kg. Maximum successive-limit change over all retained references: {max(r['reference']['convergence_error'] for r in quantities + run['diagnostics'] if 'reference' in r):.6g}. The reference admission criterion is {next(s['value'] for s in run['reference_policy'] if s['name'] == 'REFERENCE_CONVERGENCE_TOLERANCE')}."))
previous = run['diagnostics'][0]
display(Markdown(f"Esteso coefficient with the preceding association declaration: {previous['value']:.12g}; current minus preceding: {quantities[1]['value'] - previous['value']:.6g}. This does not explain the discrepancy."))
closure = density['density_diagnostic_recomputation']
display(Markdown(f"Initial density refusal: {refusal['status']}; initial molar masses: {refusal['molar_masses_kg_mol']} kg/mol. Restored removed-test declarations: {density['molar_masses_kg_mol']} kg/mol. Native normalized composition: {density['composition']}. Pressure residual: {closure['pressure'] - density['pressure_Pa']:.6g} Pa; positive pressure slope: {closure['pressure_density_derivative']:.9g} Pa m³/mol. Reduced residual: {density['convergence']['residual']:.6g}, criterion: {density['convergence']['criterion']['value']}; stop: {density['convergence']['stop']}."))
display(Markdown('### Exact source operands and execution identity'))
display(Markdown('| Comparison | Source locator | Evidence |\n|---|---|---|\n' + '\n'.join(f"| {r['case_id']} | {r['source']}: {r['locator']} | {r['evidence_label']} |" for r in rows)))
display(Markdown(f"Execution run `{run['execution_identity']['run_id']}`; Engine commit `{run['execution_identity']['engine_provenance'][0]}`; Engine tree clean: `{run['execution_identity']['engine_provenance'][1]}`. Core SHA-256 `{run['execution_identity']['core_sha256']}`. Each quantity retains this execution identity, packet hash, physical declarations and returned settings. Comparison refresh preserves that identity."))
```

The reference uses the native square-root-of-molality Richardson limit from the terminal pair of the dilution ladder.
The returned log fugacity is extrapolated, not the raw value at the reported finer rung.
The convergence diagnostic compares successive extrapolated limits and is not a rigorous error bound.
The native owner of both reference construction and formula composition is [`infinite_dilution_reference.cpp`](../../../engine/native/properties/infinite_dilution_reference.cpp).
Solvation reference records are explicitly separate diagnostic recomputations; the prediction binding does not expose the consumed reference.
Null density diagnostics on energy predictions mean unavailable evidence, not failed density closure.

The density correction restores the mass declarations from the [removed test](https://github.com/tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT/blob/fc64e9cc2a4eab98041e7fd5b4d817419809246c/engine/tests/test_density.py#L186) in [a leaf-local input](inputs/source/density-molar-masses.csv).
These masses are historical comparison declarations, not values attributed to Figiel's paper.
The native formula conversion inserts equal ion amounts on the declared solvent-molality basis; native mass projection includes the complete solution.
Pressure closure is qualified, but global phase stability is not established.
All selected thermodynamic parameters remain those of the Figiel family, including the comparison with Held's measurement.
The density discrepancy persists after correcting the missing input; its physical cause remains undetermined.
The association diagnostic changes only the mixed-solvent declaration; it is inapplicable to the ethanol-only density case.
The reference conventions, corrected Born expression and tabulated Born diameters remain fixed.
The differences from the literature averages are already present, within the printed-model comparison criterion, between the modelled and literature-average columns of Figiel SI Table S5. The current calculation reproduces the paper's calibration residuals. Their physical origin is not isolated here; this result does not justify refitting or establish independent physical validation.

The aqueous NaCl coefficient matches the [current retained Figiel chloride calculation](../../2026-figiel-divalent-chlorides/results/current-main/figiel-1to1-comparison.csv) at the same pressure. The [Haslam/Hamer–Wu comparison](../2020-haslam/notebook.qmd) assesses the adopted parameterization using [Figiel](https://doi.org/10.1021/acs.iecr.5c00475) supporting information section S2, Table S2, and checks the molality scale, stoichiometry and reference declaration. That source table concerns aqueous NaBr and supplies agreement context rather than a NaCl pointwise criterion. The supported interpretation is limited agreement with Hamer–Wu under the adopted Figiel parameters. Allocation of the remaining deviation among model terms, fitting and source selection remains undetermined.

The current criteria in [the source selection](inputs/source/literature-targets.csv) are half the printed increment, not experimental uncertainty or a general model-adequacy limit.
Historical test limits are separate fields and never determine current outcomes.
Hamer–Wu Table 16 is evaluated activity data; Esteso Table I uses salt-free solvent mass composition and molality per mass of mixed solvent.
Held Table 1 reports ambient pressure, represented here by the removed test's declared pressure approximation.
Held's instrument specification is not a total measurement uncertainty.
Pointwise uncertainty remains unknown for these selected activity coefficients and the Figiel literature averages.
Figiel SI Table S5 averages are convention-dependent calibration targets for Born diameters; they are physical comparisons, not independent physical validation.
The distinct modelled column supports numerical verification only.
Exact source locators, DOI identifiers and the cross-checked source-owner rows are retained in [comparisons.csv](results/comparisons.csv) and [source-checks.json](results/source-checks.json).

This leaf replaces the former positive-pressure replay with the selected source comparisons.
The [historical packet locks](inputs/source/data-packet-locks.json), including the stale MEA fingerprint, remain historical inventory and never select live parameters.
The broader paper studies, parameter-transcription checks and removed callback tests are outside this comparison scope.
No phase-equilibrium, transport, reactive-speciation or general predictive-accuracy claim follows.
